D1: Security Council considered Egypt's draft S/2017/1060 regarding Jerusalem. The instrument was not adopted

On 18 December 2017 at the Security Council's 8139th meeting, the Egypt-submitted draft S/2017/1060 received 14 votes in favour and one against. The United States cast the sole negative vote. The Council did not adopt the text because a permanent member voted against.
